room_rent.note: Room rent capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day subject to maximum of Rs.10,000 per day

icu.note: ICU including Digital ICU covered at 3% of Sum Insured per day, maximum Rs.20,000 per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 25% co-payment on all claims; not applicable on cataract, repatriation, home care, major disease sub-limits, and optional supportive/recovery covers. Can be modified via optional cover (20% with loading or 30% with discount).

sub_limits.display: Cataract, major diseases, modern treatments capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹35,000/eye, ₹50,000/policy year; Modern treatments: 50% of SI; Major diseases (neuro, heart, cancer, renal): SI-linked sub-limits; All other major surgeries: SI-linked sub-limits; Surgeon fees: 35% of SI; Other medical expenses: 60% of SI; Home care: 5% of SI or ₹1L; Ambulance: ₹2,500/hosp

deductible.note: No mandatory deductible in base plan. Optional voluntary aggregate deductible of ₹25,000/₹50,000/₹1,00,000 available with premium discount.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months from first policy inception with insurer

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified diseases list includes cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, spine, HPB diseases, kidney calculi, gynaec diseases, prostate, haemorrhoids, varicose veins, transplants, congenital internal diseases, and more

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Code Excl 18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined limit is 30 days subject to maximum Rs.10,000 total

post_hosp.note: Pre and post hospitalisation combined limit is 30 days subject to maximum Rs.10,000 total

day_care.display: All day-care procedures covered up to SI
day_care.note: All day care procedures/treatments covered up to sum insured

domiciliary.note: Home care treatment covered for specified conditions up to 5% of SI or Rs.1,00,000 whichever is less

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to sum insured; Yoga and Naturopathy require prior company approval

organ_donor.note: Transplant and related surgeries are listed under 24-month specific disease waiting period exclusion list; no explicit organ donor expense cover mentioned

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Rs.2,500 per hospitalisation and Rs.5,000 per policy year

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, intravitreal injections, deep brain stimulation, and other listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Consumables (List I items) covered up to sum insured only if optional cover 14 is purchased

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all investigations/treatments to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: 30-day free look period applicable on new policies only, not on renewals or portability

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, dental implants, STDs (except HIV), venereal diseases, hazardous sports, consumables (unless rider), no global cover

optional_riders.display: Consumables cover, Voluntary deductible, Supportive Care (rehab/hospice), Recovery & Enrichment Care (assisted living/nursing), Co-payment modification
